          "pseudocode": "class PlantVillageDataset(Dataset):\n    def __init__(root_dir, split, representation, split_ratio, transform=None):\n        self.class_to_idx, self.idx_to_class = build_class_mapping(root_dir)\n        all_files = list all image files under root_dir with labels\n        groups = group_by_leaf_id(all_files)\n        train_groups, test_groups = split_dataset(groups, split_ratio, seed=42)\n        self.files, self.labels = (train_groups if split=='train' else test_groups)\n        self.transform = transform or get_transforms(representation)\n    def __getitem__(idx):\n        img = PIL.Image.open(self.files[idx])\n        if representation == 'grayscale': img = img.convert('L').convert('RGB')\n        if self.transform: img = self.transform(img)\n        return img, self.labels[idx]"

      "pseudocode": "def train(config, device):\n    # Build datasets and dataloaders\n    train_dataset = PlantVillageDataset(root, 'train', representation, split_ratio)\n    test_dataset = PlantVillageDataset(root, 'test', representation, split_ratio)\n    train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=config['batch_size'], shuffle=True)\n    test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=config['batch_size'], shuffle=False)\n    # Build model\n    if model_name == 'alexnet': model = alexnet_38(pretrained=transfer_learning)\n    else: model = googlenet_38(pretrained=transfer_learning)\n    model.to(device)\n    # Optimizer & Scheduler\n    optimizer = SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.005, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0005)\n    scheduler = StepLR(optimizer, step_size=10, gamma=0.1)\n    criterion = CrossEntropyLoss()\n    # Training loop (30 epochs)\n    for epoch in range(30):\n        train_loss, train_preds, train_targets = train_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer, criterion, device)\n        val_loss, val_preds, val_targets = validate(model, test_loader, criterion, device)\n        metrics = compute_metrics(val_preds, val_targets)  # f1, precision, recall, accuracy\n        scheduler.step()\n        # Save best model by mean F1\n    return history"

      "uses": ["utils.metrics", "data.dataset", "torch", "sklearn.metrics"],
      "pseudocode": "def evaluate_model(model, test_loader, device, num_classes=38):\n    model.eval()\n    all_preds, all_targets, all_probs = [], [], []\n    with torch.no_grad():\n        for images, targets in test_loader:\n            outputs = model(images)\n            probs = softmax(outputs, dim=1)\n            preds = argmax(probs, dim=1)\n            all_preds.extend(preds)\n            all_targets.extend(targets)\n            all_probs.extend(probs)\n    f1 = f1_score(all_targets, all_preds, average='macro')\n    precision = precision_score(all_targets, all_preds, average='macro')\n    recall = recall_score(all_targets, all_preds, average='macro')\n    accuracy = accuracy_score(all_targets, all_preds)\n    top5_acc = top_k_accuracy(all_targets, all_probs, k=5)\n    return {'mean_f1': f1, 'mean_precision': precision, 'mean_recall': recall, 'accuracy': accuracy, 'top5_accuracy': top5_acc}"
    },

        {
          "name": "compute_confusion_matrix",
          "params": ["predictions: List[int]", "targets: List[int]", "num_classes: int = 38"],
          "description": "计算混淆矩阵，返回np.ndarray。"
        },
        {
          "name": "aggregate_epoch_metrics",
          "params": ["epoch_metrics: List[Dict[str, float]]"],
          "description": "聚合多epoch指标历史，计算每项指标的mean和std。用于最终报告。"
        }
      ],
      "uses": ["sklearn.metrics", "numpy"],
      "pseudocode": "def compute_metrics(predictions, targets, num_classes=38):\n    f1 = f1_score(targets, predictions, average='macro', zero_division=0)\n    precision = precision_score(targets, predictions, average='macro', zero_division=0)\n    recall = recall_score(targets, predictions, average='macro', zero_division=0)\n    acc = accuracy_score(targets, predictions)\n    return {'mean_f1': f1, 'mean_precision': precision, 'mean_recall': recall, 'accuracy': acc}\n\ndef top_k_accuracy(targets, probabilities, k=5):\n    top_k_preds = np.argsort(probabilities, axis=1)[:, -k:]\n    correct = sum(1 for i, t in enumerate(targets) if t in top_k_preds[i])\n    return correct / len(targets)"
    },
